LOCATION:
This renovated, single-family home with 2-car parking is situated in one of the city's most charming and diverse neighborhoods. Mission Street provides a cornucopia of great coffeehouses, bars, restaurants, grocery stores, and shops, all within a few blocks from your new home. Short distance to SFSU and CCSF. A commuter's dream; the financial district is approximately fifteen minutes away. It is a three-minute drive to 280 or 101 freeways for a quick commute to the valley. The BART station is at Balboa Park Station, and public transportation is everywhere. Many private, tech bus routes pick up nearby.
LEASE TERMS:
The lease is for one year, but it is fully negotiable to suit your needs. To set up a private tour, please email us through this post.

A delightful and sunny single family home in Miraloma Park with a spacious open floor plan and an airy ambiance in the living room, dining room, and the gourmet kitchen with stainless steel appliances. The second and third floors each have 2 bedrooms and 1 bathroom, with both full bathrooms having double vanities. All rooms have 8-foot ceilings, energy-efficient dual-paned windows, and beautiful solid hardwood floors throughout. The sunny and colorful garden has everything from fruit to maple to magnolia trees.
On the ground floor, the large double-car parking garage holds plenty of storage and a workshop, including a washer and dryer. The garage can fit a maximum of four cars, plus two parking spaces in the driveway.
This home is near public transportation and a great walk to all locations. It is a few steps away from Glen Canyon Park, Tower Market (Mollie Stone’s), salons, and restaurants; a walking distance from Forest Hill Muni Metro Station; and a few minutes of biking to Glen Park Village / Bart Station. There’s quick and easy access to the 280 or 101 freeways as well as the Peninsula or Financial District. Lots of green space make this an ideal place to call home.

Experience timeless San Francisco elegance in this spacious, classic Edwardian home located in the highly coveted Lake Street district. Offering 2,625 square feet of character and comfort, this 4-bedroom, 3-bathroom residence (1 full, 2 half baths) blends period craftsmanship with modern updates. A gracious entry foyer leads to a sunny south-facing living room and an elegant formal dining room featuring box-beam ceilings, a decorative fireplace, and custom built-in cabinetry.
The remodeled kitchen overlooks a low-maintenance, level garden and flows seamlessly into an open family room. With a Walk Score of 97, you are just steps away from the Clement Farmers Market, local restaurants, Mountain Lake Park, and the Presidio.
Key Amenities & Features:
Spacious Layout: 4 bedrooms plus a dedicated home office, 3 bathrooms, and 2,625 sq. ft. of living space.
Classic Period Details: Box-beam ceilings, intricate built-ins, and two decorative fireplaces.
Modern Living Spaces: Remodeled kitchen with island, adjacent family room, walk-in pantry, and a dedicated laundry room.
Parking & Storage: Attached 2-car tandem garage with ample storage space, plus a large attic.
Outdoor Living: Private, level, and low-maintenance backyard garden.
Prime Location: Located in the Lake Street neighborhood near Mountain Lake Park, the Presidio, local dining, and public transit.
Lease Details:
Monthly Rent: $6,100
Property Type: Single Family Residence (Edwardian)
Address: 4526 California St, San Francisco, CA 94118
To inquire about this apartment please mail your email.

Ideally situated close to public transportation and BART, this home is convenient to restaurants, banks, produce stores, a private K-8 school, and the neighborhood library.

Welcome to this exceptionally well-designed 4-bedroom, 3-bathroom residence occupying the private middle floor of a boutique SoMa building. A shared elevator services the building, offering convenient access from the ground level directly to your unit.
This location is a commuter’s dream. Enjoy effortless transit access with a quick 2-to-3-minute drive to both the US-101, I-280 and I-80 freeways. For public transit, the Civic Center BART station is just a short 10-minute walk away, and the Caltrain station is accessible within a 15-minute walk.
The intelligent floor plan perfectly balances privacy and shared living. The front features two bright, versatile bedrooms—ideal for guests, children, or a quiet home office. The heart of the home opens into an expansive kitchen, living, and dining area anchored by a massive central island designed for entertaining. Tucked quietly at the rear are two private master suites, offering a peaceful retreat from the city. Residents also enjoy a shared top-floor roof deck with panoramic SF skyline views, plus a dedicated ground-floor garage space and storage.
Key Features & Amenities:
* Prime Transit Location: 2-3 mins to US-101 & I-80; 10-min walk to Civic Center BART; 15-min walk to Caltrain.
* Chef's Kitchen: Massive central island between the kitchen and living room.
* Outdoor Space: Access to a shared top-floor roof deck with stunning SF skyline views.
* Parking & Storage: 1 secure ground-floor garage space with an attached storage room right in front.
* Intelligent Layout: Split-bedroom design with central living space for ultimate privacy.
* Master Suites: Two spacious master bedrooms located quietly at the back of the home.
* Front Bedrooms: Two additional well-sized bedrooms facing the front.
* Laundry: Dedicated in-unit washer and dryer.
Rental Terms & Criteria
* Monthly Rent: $9,250
* Lease Duration: 18-24-month lease (preferred)
* Looking for a qualified tenant to move in by August 8th or 9th. First month's rent will be fully prorated based on your move-in date.

Restaurants, shops and SF Public Library abound on Taraval St. as well as convenient access to the L Taraval for a quick trip to downtown or to the SF Zoo! EASY access to 19th Ave / Sunset Blvd.

Four bedroom, modern, spacious, and beautiful full floor flat available for rent.  Entire unit completely and newly renovated from studs in including all new sheetrock, plumbing, electrical, windows, finishes, etc.  The entire flat is for rent.
FLAT DETAILS:
Four separate bedrooms.  Three of the bedrooms are very large and one bedroom is average to large sized.  Tenants to determine breakdown of rent between rooms.
Great Room – large, spacious, modern and open concept kitchen and living room.  Unwind in this spacious living room, be part of the fun while cooking meals, entertain friends and guests in an expansive setting, etc.  The kitchen has a built-in long designer quartz island table (seating for 8) with undermount LED lighting, pantry, all stainless steel appliances, like dishwasher, refrigerator and stove, garbage disposal, base and wall cabinet glass doors, soft close cabinets, etc.
Entire unit is modern and new, from new sheetrock to all new finishes, to new double pane windows everywhere, new dark hardwood floors, etc.  Guts of building such as electrical, plumbing and central heat systems are brand new too. Features include Decora light switches and switches on dimmers, multiple plug outlets/receptacles in each and all rooms as required by latest codes, all new drains and water lines everywhere, new central heat gas furnace system delivering heat throughout entire flat.
The photos show just a small fraction of the hotels, retailers, galleries, restaurants, etc., most of which are seconds walk from the full floor flat, and all within two or three minutes walk from the flat.  All the hotels are within seconds walk of the flat.  The retailers, galleries, restaurants and hotels show what the area is like.
Very dark and solid hardwood floors throughout entire flat, including all bedrooms, closets, hallway, living room, etc., except bathrooms which are tiled with large, modern and clean style format porcelain tiles.
Recessed lighting everywhere.
New and large double pane windows everywhere.
In flat/unit laundry room with front load, high efficiency washer and dryer for exclusive use by only the one flat.  Laundry room has large separate area for folding, additional storage, laundry baskets, etc.
Separate one full bathroom, with modern and clean design Kohler tub, shower, designer sink, toilet, etc.
Completely separate and additional half bathroom, with designer sink and toilet.
In unit central heat, high efficiency gas furnace providing heat throughout entire flat and all rooms with auto temperature on and off control.
Outdoor space, rear balcony for private use by this flat only.
Separate large hallway closet for further additional storage, etc.
Modern and large format, designer dark in color porcelain tiles in tub to ceiling and throughout all floor areas of bathrooms.
Lots of natural light.
Intercom and automatic gate release.
Top floor flat.
Secure package receiving area with digital gate accessible by Amazon, United Parcel Service (UPS), United States Postal Service (USPS), etc., to drop off your packages.
LOCATION DETAILS:
Located in Nob Hill, two blocks to Financial District, two blocks to the actual Union Square Plaza, one building off Powell Cable Car line, half-block to Ritz Carlton and one block to The Mark Hopkins and Fairmont Hotel, etc.
The immediate area, just steps from the front door, is one of the densest concentration of restaurants, bistros, bars, theaters, spas, luxury shops and retailers, art galleries, night clubs, hip night spots of all types, wine merchants, lounges, hotels, booksellers, cafes, specialty and large groceries, etc., a host of countless commercial businesses, in San Francisco. One of the most sought after and hottest areas in all of San Francisco.  The immediate area is San Francisco’s premier shopping district as well, from Gucci, to Prada, to Saks Fifth Avenue, etc.
The photos show just a small fraction of the hotels, retailers, galleries, restaurants, etc., most of which are seconds walk from the full floor flat, and all within two or three minutes walk from the flat.  All the hotels are within seconds walk of the flat.  The retailers, galleries, restaurants and hotels show what the area is like.
Restaurants in the immediate area, some of the trendiest, include the Tonga Room, Rue Lepic, Nob Hill Restaurant, Parallel 37, Big Four Restaurant, Scala’s, Farallon, Oak Room, Café Bastille, etc., and the more traditional fares include Sears, Morton Steak House, E&O Trading, Sam’s Grill & Seafood, Cheesecake Factory, Dining Room at the Ritz, etc.  Within steps and just a block or two away are dozens of bars, night clubs, music venues, and lounges, from traditional to eclectic like the Huntington, Belden Traverna, Harry Denton’s Starlight Room, Top of the Mark, Burritt Room, Rickhouse, Sugar Café, The Cellar, Cantina, etc.  Art galleries and department stores include Pasquale Lannetti Art Gallery, Jenkins Johnson Gallery, Mishin Gallery, Bernstein S. & Co., Meridian Gallery, Caldwell Snyder Gallery, Gallery 444, Saks Fifth Avenue, Tiffany’s, Macy’s, Gucci, Prada, Louis Vuitton, and countless others.  In the immediate area are also traditional conveniences such as E & E Fine Foods, J & W Market, Trader Joe’s, Food Fair Market, Bush Market, etc.  The flat offers a beautiful and modern place to live and get away, in the midst of an area that is vibrant and full of life day and night.
The building/flat is located 1.06 miles to the on and off ramps of all of the San Francisco Freeways, including U.S. 101 and U.S. 280 (southbound to Silicon Valley/San Jose/Peninsula/etc. and northbound to Golden Gate Bridge/Marin/etc.) and 1.16 miles to U.S. 80 (eastbound to Berkeley/Hayward/Walnut Creek/Oakland/etc.), providing quick and easy access to all parts of the Bay Area.
Numerous South Bay companies have pick up points in the area.
Area served by various modes of public transportation as well.
Parking, if needed, is non-metered on the block the building is located, on both sides of the street, on the cross streets, up the street, on some of the parallel streets and the other cross streets (which seems to change hands frequently because of commercial nature of some of the area).  There are also numerous parking garages with hundreds or thousands of parking spaces a stones throw from building, such as the Sutter-Stockton garage (at cross street of building, ½ block down), Crocker Garage (which has walk in and out entrances on Pine Street), etc.
